A '''clone lieutenant''' was a [[human]] [[clone trooper]] who served as a [[Biker Advanced Recon Commando]] in the [[91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]]. The [[Clone Lieutenant]] served alongside their respective [[Jedi]] [[officer]] and [[corps]] [[commander]], [[Jedi General]] [[Stass Allie]] and [[Clone Commander]] [[Neyo]]. Following the [[Siege of Saleucami]], the [[lieutenant]] was on a routine patrol alongside their superiors when they and Neyo received [[Order 66]] from [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]], forcing them to use their [[BARC speeder]]s to shoot down and [[Death|kill]] their Jedi [[General]].

==Biography==
[[Reproduction|Grown]] on the [[planet]] [[Kamino]] from the [[DNA]] of [[Jango Fett]], a [[bounty hunter]] who became the [[Clone template|template]] of the [[clone trooper]] [[army]],<ref name="Clone Troopers" /> the [[Cloning|clone]] served as a [[Biker Advanced Recon Commando]],<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref> and at one point received the [[military rank]] of [[Clone Lieutenant]] within the [[Grand Army of the Republic]]. The [[lieutenant]] took part in the pan-[[The galaxy|galactic]] [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], serving within the Republic's [[91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps]] alongside [[Jedi General]] [[Stass Allie]] and [[Clone Marshal Commander]] [[Neyo]].<ref name="HC 33" />

The lieutenant remained active during the [[Outer Rim Sieges]]<ref name="Episode III" /> in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> where they served on [[Saleucami]] alongside the rest of their unit. Following the [[Siege of Saleucami]], the lieutenant<ref name="HC 33" /> was part of a [[squad]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> that went on a routine patrol on a former battlefield alongside their superiors, [[General]] Allie and the [[Commander]] Neyo,<ref name="Episode III" /> serving as the latter's wingmate.<ref name="SWCT">{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=Stass Allie - Jedi Master}}</ref> At that [[time]], the two [[clone trooper officer]]s received [[Order 66]] from [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]]. Obeying the command,<ref name="HC 33" /> the clone [[officer]]s quickly nodded at each other and slowed down their [[BARC speeder]]s. Once they were behind their unsuspecting Jedi officer, the clones quickly used their [[speeder]]s' [[laser cannon]]s to blast Stass Allie's [[74-Z speeder bike]] into pieces, [[Death|killing]] her instantly.<ref name="Episode III" />

==Personality and traits==
As a clone<ref name="Episode III" /> of the [[bounty]] [[Hunting|hunter]] Jango Fett, the BARC trooper was a [[human]] who stood at 1.83 [[meter]]s tall and had [[Color|tan]] skin.<ref name="Clone Troopers" />

==Skills and abilities==
As a Biker Advanced Recon Commando,<ref name="Episode III" /> the clone was specially trained to utilize BARC speeders across difficult terrain,<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> and served as an officer within the Grand Army of the Republic.<ref name="HC 33" />

==Equipment==
The lieutenant wore [[Phase II clone trooper armor]] that was identical to the [[armor]] set worn by Commander Neyo. This included the markings of the 91st Recon Corps, a small [[pauldron]] on their right shoulder, an [[Advanced Recon Commando|ARC trooper]] sash, an integrated communicator on their right forearm, and an equipment belt.<ref name="Episode III" />
